summary.en-US: Bulk pricing, sales scheduling and earnings reports for Roblox creators: clothing, UGC, game passes, developer products and badges.

description.en-US:
RoBulk adds a bulk editing panel to the Roblox Creator Dashboard (create.roblox.com).

Put dozens of items on or off sale at once, change prices with rules (raise by %, round to prices ending in 9), schedule sales, rename in bulk, and manage regional and managed pricing. Every change is staged for review before anything is saved.

The Earnings report shows daily earnings, best sellers, top buyers and a category breakdown. You can also bulk-create game passes and developer products from templates, copy them between experiences, manage badges, and undo changes from daily snapshots.

RoBulk has no servers, analytics or accounts. It only talks to Roblox, using the login you already have.

Not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.

version.approval_notes: Content script runs only on create.roblox.com. To try it you need a Roblox account; click RoBulk in the Creator Dashboard's left sidebar, below All tools. Source is built with Vite from TypeScript: npm ci && npm run package produces dist-firefox/.
